descriptions.preferred: This deeply divided red form has leaves with slender lobes which separate almost to the leaf base. The lobes are long, narrow, ovate-lanceolate. The leaves measure up to 8 cm long, and the lobes are 5-10 mm broad. The edges are partly double serrated with many sharp teeth. New leaves are often pale crimson but open to a rich purple red. However, they do not color well in deep shade. As the season progresses, a bronze green to dark green color appears. Fall color is a rather bright crimson. This cascading maple is not as fully drooping as some cultivars. Older plants make a moundlike tall shrub, 3 m tall and wide. 'Chitose yama' is an excellent cultivar of the older type and is found quite widely in collections and some nurseries. It is often used as a specimen in containers and occasionally for bonsai. According to van Gelderen et al. (1994), plants sold under this name in Europe have olive brown to olive green leaves turning orange yellow in the fall, but this does not fit the original description by Kobayashi (1974). The latter agrees with the description above. Archives, Corvallis bush, up to 1.5 m tall and broad. This beautiful little maple has bright green leaf forms. The leaves vary, as do those of most dwarf or "yatsubusa" forms, having very tiny leaves on older wood and larger (more palmate) leaves on new shoots. On mature wood, the leaf nodes are very close together, creating a dense cover of foliage along the twigs. The tendency to multibranching adds to the compact formation of foliage clusters. The twigs and branches are thin but stiff. Most leaves on the old wood measure about 2 cm long and wide. New growth produces foliage 3-4 cm wide. The leaf is five lobed and rather typically palmate. The lobe is broad-ovate and acuminate, with a sharp tip. The margins are toothed, sometimes bluntly so. After growing this cultivar for several years, it has becomeoneof myfavoritedwarf types.Itperformsextremely well in the landscape, takes on a natural globe shape withoutmuchpruning,isvigorouswithoutbeingunruly, andhasattractivefoliageinallseasons.

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 中等大小的落叶灌木，株形紧凑、呈圆拱堆丘状。叶片初展时浅红色，后转为古铜绿色，几乎深裂至基部，分成 7 个渐尖裂片；秋季转鲜红色。花小，紫色

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一深裂红叶类型的叶片具细长裂片，几乎一直分开到叶基。裂片细长、狭窄，呈卵状披针形。叶片长可达 8 厘米，裂片宽 5–10 毫米。叶缘部分为重锯齿，具许多锐利细齿。新叶常呈淡深绯红色，展开后转为浓郁的紫红色。不过在深阴环境下着色不佳。随着季节推进，叶色会带上古铜绿至深绿色。秋色为较明亮的深绯红色。该下垂型槭树的枝条下垂程度不如某些品种明显。老株会形成隆起状的大型灌木，高和宽均约 3 米。'Chitose yama' 是一个非常优秀的老式品种，在各类收藏和部分苗圃中分布较广。它常被用作容器中的标本植物，偶尔也用于盆景。根据 van Gelderen 等（1994）的说法，欧洲以此名销售的植株叶色为橄榄褐至橄榄绿，秋季转橙黄色，但这与 Kobayashi（1974）的原始描述不符；后者与上述描述一致。Archives, Corvallis。灌木，高与幅均可达 1.5 米。这一美丽的小型槭树具有鲜绿色叶型。叶片变化较大，和大多数矮生或“yatsubusa”类型一样，老枝上的叶片很小，而新梢上的叶片较大，也更接近典型掌状。成熟枝上的节间极短，使枝条上形成致密叶幕；其多分枝倾向也加强了这种紧凑的叶簇结构。小枝和枝条细而硬挺。老枝上的多数叶片约长、宽各 2 厘米；新梢叶片宽 3–4 厘米。叶片 5 裂，形态相当典型，为掌状；裂片宽卵形，先端渐尖且尖锐。叶缘具齿，有时齿较钝。栽培该品种数年后，它已成为我最喜欢的矮生类型之一。它在景观中表现极佳，几乎无需修剪就能自然形成球形，生长有力却不杂乱，且四季叶色都有观赏性。
